hints.title: Destination Terminal Condition
hints.text: The destination node must be a terminal sink, meaning it must have zero outgoing edges. If destination has any outgoing edges, paths can continue past it.

hints.title: Three-Color Cycle Detection
hints.text: During traversal, use three states (unvisited, active in current path, fully verified) to detect any cycle that could cause infinite walking.

hints.title: Dead-End and Reachability Verification
hints.text: Every node with zero outgoing edges reachable from source must be the destination itself. If any leaf is not destination or a cycle is detected, return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Naive path enumeration risks traversing cycles infinitely and taking exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Three-state DFS traversal visits each vertex and edge once in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check destination out-degree 0, leaf equivalence to destination, and cycle freedom.
complexity.notes: State 1 represents active path ancestors, enabling O(1) cycle detection.
